transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Thank you. Um, well, I came in because I barely sleep in any useful way anymore. I just... I'll lie awake at night replaying client financial models in my head. And then I end up waking up at 3 or 4 in the morning, and my stomach is just tight. By the time I have to get up and go to work, I feel like I never actually rested at all.
Outside of feeling exhausted from the poor sleep, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

Yeah, I have. Um... most days I just have this heavy, gray feeling. It's like I'm just going through the motions, whether I'm at the office or just walking around my apartment. Honestly, I spend a lot of time just trying not to cry when someone asks me a completely normal question.
How long have you been feeling this way and having these sleep issues?

Um... it's been about three years now. It started ever since the merger reorganized our Caribbean-market division at work. I've just been feeling this way, and dealing with the sleep issues, ever since then.
During these past three years, have you had any periods lasting two months or more where you felt like your normal self?

No. Um... no, I haven't. I haven't really had a break from it at all. There definitely hasn't been a chunk of time like two months where I felt normal. It's just been pretty much every single day for the last three years.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities and hobbies you used to enjoy?

Um... no, not really. I still care about the things I usually do outside of work. I haven't lost interest in my hobbies or anything like that, I just... I still enjoy them, I just feel tired while I'm doing them. But the interest is definitely still there.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite, such as eating much less or much more than usual?
No, my appetite hasn't really changed. I'm eating about the same amount I always have. I haven't noticed any weight gain or loss, either. It's just pretty much normal.
During these past three years, how have you been feeling about yourself, such as having low self-esteem or feeling like a failure?

Um, yeah, my self-esteem has been pretty low. I definitely struggle with feeling like a failure. It happens a lot at work... like, if a manager questions one of my financial projections, I don't just take it as a normal work question. I immediately hear it as confirmation that I'm just not as sharp as I used to be. It makes me feel like everyone around me can see that I'm failing.

inference_history.note: Initial presentation of chronic non-restorative sleep, early morning awakenings, somatic tension, and work-related cognitive rumination suggests generalized anxiety disorder, depressive episode, primary insomnia, adjustment disorder, or unspecified anxiety.
